additional_info.subject: RE: ID0401006-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R6 313065117087] The device is stuck on the 'Hello-Hallo' screen CRM:00642001954
additional_info.body:
Hello Yunus,
Hope you are doing great.
Please help me with the following quick queries:
If the screen is stuck on the "Hello" screen, is the touch functionality still operational?
Have you tried using a different Ethernet cable?
After trying that, did you notice a clinking noise coming from the main unit (with the door switch bypassed)?
Have you flashed the CFast card and tried again?
We also recommend carrying a CFast card with a prepared live Linux system, along with a router and an Ethernet cable.
Have you performed any preventive maintenance on this charger?
If the charger is rebooted or switched on after, for example, preventive maintenance, and there is a bad Ethernet connection, it will get stuck on the default "Hello" screen with no SCB connection. If you connect your laptop locally to the main unit, you will see fault flags via the companion tool
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Mohini
